results.title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
results.original_title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
results.overview: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

results.title: Poniiy
results.overview: A young local girl's family cares for a dog named Poniiy, whose true owner, a kind-hearted man, has mysteriously gone missing. Determined to reunite them, the girl and Poniiy set out on a heartfelt journey to find him.

results.title: FULL DISCLOSURE: THE REALITY BEHIND SPIELBERG'S DISCLOSURE DAY
results.original_title: FULL DISCLOSURE: THE REALITY BEHIND SPIELBERG'S DISCLOSURE DAY
results.overview: An exclusive look at the making of "Disclosure Day," featuring interviews with Steven Spielberg, Emily Blunt and more, hosted by Gadi Schwartz.

results.title: Independence: Keeper of the Prophecy
results.overview: In 1911, Mongolia stands at a historic turning point. After more than two centuries of Manchu foreign rule under the Qing Dynasty, a secret resistance forms to reclaim a free and sovereign nation. At the forefront of this dangerous movement are the visionary Bogd Khan and the determined minister Namnansuren. Navigating diplomatic negotiations with Russia and building an underground intelligence network, the insurgents must break through a web of espionage and political intrigue. As the situation escalates, a armed conflict erupts, forcing the rebels to pay with bloody sacrifices to secure the dream of freedom and protect a sacred prophecy.

results.title: Echte Mannen Huilen Niet
results.overview: In the Netherlands, a large proportion of men face mental health challenges. However, openness regarding this remains rare, especially in the world of football. What does it mean to act strong in a culture where silence is the norm? A group of professional football players gather in a retreat to start to open themselves up to themselves and to others.

results.title: HOA Heist
results.overview: Neighbors take on a secret HOA mission.

results.title: We Want the Virus
results.overview: After a blacked out night of drinking, two lifelong friends and struggling actors wake up and realize they raised 22 thousand dollars falsely claiming they had the Coronavirus, and now must go to extreme lengths in order to obtain the virus and collect their cash.

results.original_title: Yoa en concert à We Love Green 2026

results.title: Wildcards
results.overview: A jury deliberating the case of Theodore Sterling, a privileged young man accused of sexual assault of a 20-something African-American woman. The prosecution is led by Assistant State Attorney James Jones, an overworked yet determined prosecutor, who faces off against Greg Sims, a veteran defense attorney with an unbroken 25-year winning streak.

results.title: Honey or Poison
results.overview: Azura has spent years of her life as the perfect wife to Adli, a wealthy but selfish husband whose decision to remarry shakes the life she has built. When Nikita, a young woman who is bold and harbors a secretive past, enters their home, competition and jealousy begin to ignite. However, when both of them face Adli's manipulative behavior and cruelty, an unexpected bond begins to form. When a violent confrontation costs Adli his life, Azura and Nikita are bound by a dangerous secret. As the police investigation draws closer to the truth and old secrets begin to unravel, they must determine how far they are willing to go to protect each other.

results.title: Inside the Dream: Audemars Piguet
results.overview: A secretive and codified world, Haute Horlogerie rarely invites cameras behind the scenes. For the first time, Audemars Piguet opens its doors, unveiling the creation of a unique timepiece. In the heart of the Vallée de Joux, designers, artisans, watchmakers and engineers come together to push the limits of their craft and bring an exceptional watch to life.

results.title: billykid
results.overview: A photojournalist joins her childhood friend on a doomed heist for a Magic 8 Ball in their hometown of Hillsborough, North Carolina.

results.title: Animal Farm
results.overview: All animals are free.  All animals are equal.  No animal will kill.

results.title: Let This Stay Between Us
results.overview: After becoming involved with his student, a university professor is torn between desire and professional ethics. Determined to safeguard their secret relationship, he puts his personal and professional stability on the line.

results.title: Tancredi (Teatro dell'Opera di Roma)
results.overview: Michele Mariotti conducts Gioachino Rossini’s *Tancredi* for the first time. Carlo Vistoli takes on the title role. Joining him on stage are Martina Russomanno, Antonino Siragusa, and Luca Tittoto. Directed by Emma Dante, with set design by Carmine Maringola. The Orchestra and Chorus of the Teatro dell’Opera di Roma.

results.title: Huyền Tình Dạ Trạch
results.overview: Huyền Tình Dạ Trạch is not only a romantic ballad about a love that defies all conventions between the devoted young man Chử Đồng Tử and Princess Tiên Dung, but also an epic journey that takes audiences back to the splendor of Đông Sơn culture. Their fateful meeting in the vast Dạ Trạch marsh becomes both a symbol of immortal love and a shared odyssey of settlement, survival, and humanity’s struggle to master nature in the age of Văn Lang.

results.title: L'amie en commun
results.overview: In life, there are only two kinds of moments: meetings and breakups. This is the story of a breakup and two meetings. Or maybe the other way around.

results.title: This Above All: The Theatrical Life of Antoni Cimolino
results.original_title: This Above All: The Theatrical Life of Antoni Cimolino
results.overview: As his final season approaches, the longest serving Artistic Director of the iconic Stratford Festival, Antoni Cimolino, prepares for his exit while reflecting on the 40 years he's devoted to the theatrical repertory company.
